chapter: South America and back in New York
title: Closing interview three; opening interview four; his firsts
summary: Albertson ends the session, opens interview four on April 27, 1975, and notes Wooding was the first to take a jazz band to Russia, record abroad and go to South America.

Okay, this is Chris Albertson with Sam Wooding for the Smithsonian Institution, April 27, 1975. This is Interview 4.

Sam, we were talking about your trip to Russia. And, as we left it, you had been in South America. And I just wanted to mention that actually, you were the first person to bring a band -- a jazz band, into Russia. You were also the first American jazz band, or American band, to record outside of the United States, when you made those recordings in Berlin in 1925. And, I believe you were the first band to go into South America.
